notes: The ASV reorders the two partitive phrases; each מִן takes the preposition standing before its own noun, so the first holds *in* before *battles* and the second *Out of* before *the spoil* (rules 24, 25).
*won* is a supplied lexical participle answering to no morpheme and is added under rule 20; the waw the ASV leaves unrendered is unrepresented under rule 14.
The marginal gloss *Hebrew Out of the battles and the spoil* was read and set aside under rule 38.
